policy.knownLand: Use actual valid optical, otherwise provenance-bound real BMNG fallback. Fallback does not satisfy high-resolution coverage.
policy.knownWater: Preserve provenance-bound real baseline. Class80 is annual permanent-water classification, not proof of historical/tidal coast.
policy.unknown: Preserve baseline and unknown status. NoData and wetlands never imply ocean.
policy.height: Only decoded DSM sample validity currently available; native contributing-pixel and derivative-neighborhood completeness remain unproven. Never replace invalid elevation by zero.

limits: Modern2004/2020/2021 sources are not1950 imagery or shoreline.
Candidate data preparation is not runtime/source admission or visual acceptance.
No GPU start, engine render, build or historical PASS rerun.
